steps.title: Worksheet 13 hanger bracket: extrude the top plate
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as ws13_hanger.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane (the top). Draw a rectangle 130 by 25, centred.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 hanger bracket: two holes 6 diameter
actions: Hole: Placement = on the top face, 7.5 from each end on the centre line. Simple hole, diameter 6, Through All. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 hanger bracket: extrude the web
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane (the front). Draw lines from the plate 100 apart down to touch a circle 40 diameter 125 below the plate, and close it round the circle.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Symmetric, Distance 5, Join. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 hanger bracket: cut the window
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the web face. Draw a triangle 15 in from each edge (the 15 arm width), then Fillet the sketch corners: R10 at the top two, R5 at the bottom.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Cut, Through All. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 hanger bracket: extrude the boss
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the web face. Draw a circle 40 diameter at the bottom of the web.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Symmetric, Distance 15, Join. OK.

steps.title: Worksheet 13 hanger bracket: bore 20 diameter
actions: Hole: Concentric with the boss, diameter 20, Through All. OK. Save.
steps.note: The web thickness (5) and the hole positions (7.5 from the ends) are scaled from the worksheet drawing.
